SELECT A.AS_NO ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C000','C010') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag1 /*대기,팀장승인*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C004') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag2 /*처리중*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C005','C012') AND A.COMPLETE_DT LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag3 /*처리완료*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C009','C011','C013') AND A.ACCEPT_DT LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag4 /*반려(반려,팀장반려,배포반려)*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C000', 'C010', 'C004') AND A.INQUIRY_DT < TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag5 /*지연*/ FROM CRM_AS_MGT A, CRM_CUST_MGT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.CUST_SEQ = B.SEQ AND (A.DEL_YN IS NULL OR A.DEL_YN = 'N') AND A.ASSIGN_ID = (SELECT EMP_NO FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE RETIRE_DATE IS NULL AND EMP_NO = A.ASSIGN_ID ) AND A.ASSIGN_ID = #{reg_id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND B.CUST_GUBUN = #{cust_gubun}

SELECT A.AS_NO , CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS = 'C002' AND A.ACCEPT_DT LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag1 /*담당자배정중*/ , CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C003','C004') AND A.ACCEPT_DT LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag2 /*배정완료,처리중*/ , CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C005') AND A.ACCEPT_DT LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag3 /*처리완료*/ , CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS NOT IN ('C005','C006','C007','C008','C009','C011','C012','C013') AND A.PROC_DT || A.PROC_TIME < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag4 /*처리지연중*/ , CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C009','C011','C013') AND A.ACCEPT_DT LIKE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag5 /*반려(반려,팀장반려,배포반려)*/ FROM CRM_AS_MGT A, CRM_CUST_MGT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.CUST_SEQ = B.SEQ AND (A.DEL_YN IS NULL OR A.DEL_YN = 'N') AND A.ASSIGN_ID = #{reg_id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND B.CUST_GUBUN = #{cust_gubun}

SELECT A.AS_NO ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C000','C010') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag1 /*대기, 팀장승인*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C004') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag2 /*처리중*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C005','C012') AND SUBSTR(A.COMPLETE_DT,1,6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag3 /*처리완료*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C009','C011','C013') AND SUBSTR(A.ACCEPT_DT,1,6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag4 /*반려(반려,팀장반려,배포반려)*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C000', 'C010', 'C004') AND A.INQUIRY_DT < TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag5 /*지연*/ FROM ( SELECT C.* ,(SELECT DEPT2_CD FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE EMP_NO = ASSIGN_ID ) AS DEPT2_CD FROM CRM_AS_MGT C )A, CRM_CUST_MGT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.CUST_SEQ = B.SEQ AND A.ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND (A.DEL_YN IS NULL OR A.DEL_YN = 'N') AND A.DEPT2_CD = (SELECT DEPT2_CD FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE EMP_NO = #{reg_id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND A.ASSIGN_ID = (SELECT EMP_NO FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE RETIRE_DATE IS NULL AND EMP_NO = A.ASSIGN_ID )
AND B.CUST_GUBUN = #{cust_gubun}

SELECT A.AS_NO ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS = 'C001' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag1 /*접수*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C002') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag2 /*담당자배정중*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C003','C004') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag3 /*배정완료,처리중*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C005') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag4 /*처리완료*/ ,CASE WHEN A.PROC_STATUS IN ('C009','C011','C013') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag5 /*반려(반려,팀장반려,배포반려)*/ FROM CRM_AS_MGT A, CRM_CUST_MGT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.CUST_SEQ = B.SEQ AND A.ACCEPT_DT IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTR(A.ACCEPT_DT,1,6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') AND (A.DEL_YN IS NULL OR A.DEL_YN = 'N')
AND B.CUST_GUBUN = #{cust_gubun}

SELECT DISTINCT(A.APPLY_NM) AS APPLY_NM ,NVL(A.APPLY_ID,'') AS APPLY_ID ,C.CUST_KOR_NAME ,C.ERP_CODE ,E.EMP_GRADE ,E.TEL_NO ,E.EMAIL FROM CRM_AS_MGT A, CRM_CUST_MGT C, CRM_CUST_EMP E WHERE 1=1 AND A.CUST_CODE = C.ERP_CODE AND A.APPLY_ID = E.EMP_ID(+) AND (A.DEL_YN IS NULL OR A.DEL_YN = 'N') AND A.PROC_STATUS NOT IN('C006','C007') AND A.ASSIGN_ID = #{reg_id}

SELECT IN_TB.CUST_CODE ,CM.CUST_KOR_NAME ,IN_TB.F1 ,IN_TB.F2 ,ROUND((IN_TB.F1 / IN_TB.F2) * 100 ,0)AS RATIO FROM (WITH A AS( SELECT CUST_CODE ,COUNT( AS_NO )AS F1 FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE 1=1 AND PROC_STATUS ='C005' AND DEL_YN IS NULL GROUP BY CUST_CODE ), B AS( SELECT CUST_CODE ,COUNT( AS_NO )AS F2 FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE 1=1 AND PROC_STATUS NOT IN('C007','C008')
AND DEL_YN IS NULL GROUP BY CUST_CODE) SELECT NVL(A.CUST_CODE,B.CUST_CODE) CUST_CODE ,NVL(A.F1,'0') F1 ,NVL(B.F2,'0') F2 FROM A FULL JOIN B ON A.CUST_CODE = B.CUST_CODE ) IN_TB, CRM_CUST_MGT CM WHERE 1=1 AND IN_TB.CUST_CODE = CM.ERP_CODE
AND CM.CUST_GUBUN = #{cust_gubun}
ORDER BY RATIO

SELECT SUM(A.PRO_SEQ) AS F1 ,SUM(DECODE(STATE_TYPE, 'C001',1,0)) AS F2 ,SUM(CASE WHEN STATE_TYPE IN('C002','C003','C004','C005') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS F3 ,SUM(DECODE(STATE_TYPE,'C006',1,0)) AS F4 FROM CRM_PROJECT_MGT A,CRM_CUST_MGT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.CUST_SEQ = B.SEQ AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') BETWEEN SUBSTR(A.TERM_START_DT, 1, 4) AND SUBSTR(A.TERM_END_DT, 1, 4)
AND B.CUST_GUBUN = #{cust_gubun}

SELECT A.PRO_SEQ --PRO SEQ , A.ERP_CODE --ERPCODE , G.CUST_KOR_NAME --거래처명 , G.CUST_GUBUN --거래처명 , A.PROJECT_NM --프로젝트명 , A.SYSTEM_CODE --시스템코드 , B.CODE_NAME AS SYSTEM_NAME --시스템명 , A.STATE_TYPE --상태코드 , C.CODE_NAME AS PROJECT_STATUS , A.PJT_CODE --수주심의코드 , A.TERM_START_DT -- 프로젝트시작일 , A.TERM_END_DT --프로젝트종료일 , A.OPEN_DT --전산오픈일 , A.TEST_DT --최종검수일 , NVL2(F.PJT_CODE, CASE WHEN NVL(F.KYUL_1_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(F.KYUL_2_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(F.KYUL_3_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '[ 완료 ]' WHEN NVL(F.KYUL_1_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(F.KYUL_2_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(F.KYUL_3_YN, 'N') = 'N' THEN '[ 최종결재 대기중 ]' WHEN NVL(F.KYUL_1_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(F.KYUL_2_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(F.KYUL_3_YN, 'N') = 'N' THEN '[ 구매확인요청 진행중 ]' END , '' ) AS SU_ORDER_STAT --수주심의상태 , E.TOTAL_AMT --수주심의 총계약금액 , NVL2((SELECT MAX(STATUS) FROM KYERP.TB_SD_SALES_ORDER_MST@DL_ONTIC WHERE PJT_CODE = A.PJT_CODE AND STATUS = '00003'),'[ 완료 ]','') AS CON_ORDER_STAT FROM CRM_PROJECT_MGT A , CRM_CODE_DETAIL B , CRM_CODE_DETAIL C , KYERP.TB_CM_CUSTOMER@DL_ONTIC D , KYERP.TB_SD_PJT_CUSTCODE@DL_ONTIC E , KYERP.TB_SD_PJT_MST@DL_ONTIC F , CRM_CUST_MGT G WHERE 1=1 AND B.CODE_GROUP(+) = 'PROJECT' AND B.P_CODE(+) = 'PR02' AND B.CODE(+) = A.SYSTEM_CODE AND C.CODE_GROUP(+) = 'PROJECT' AND C.P_CODE(+) = 'PR01' AND C.CODE(+) = A.STATE_TYPE AND D.CUST_CD(+) = A.ERP_CODE AND E.PJT_CODE(+) = A.PJT_CODE AND F.PJT_CODE(+) = E.PJT_CODE AND A.ERP_CODE = G.ERP_CODE
AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') BETWEEN SUBSTR(A.TERM_START_DT, 1, 4) AND SUBSTR(A.TERM_END_DT, 1, 4)

SELECT H.COST_GUBUN ,H.CUST_CODE ,E.CUST_KOR_NAME ,ITEM_GRP3 ,ITEM_GRP3_NM ,ITEM_CD ,ITEM_NM ,CONTR_ST_DT ,CONTR_END_DT ,AMT ,CUST_GUBUN ,DEAL_CODE ,E.SEQ
FROM CUST_CONTRACT_HIT H, CRM_CUST_MGT E WHERE 1=1 AND H.CUST_CODE = E.ERP_CODE AND DEAL_CODE NOT IN ('C003','C004') --거래처 해지,폐지 제외
AND CUST_GUBUN = #{cust_gubun}
AND COST_GUBUN IN('2','1')
AND COST_GUBUN = '2'
AND COST_GUBUN = '2' AND CONTR_END_DT < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')
AND COST_GUBUN = '1'
AND COST_GUBUN = '1' AND CONTR_END_DT < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') = SUBSTR(CONTR_END_DT,0,4)
AND COST_GUBUN = '1' AND CONTR_END_DT < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE , -12) , 'YYYY') = SUBSTR(CONTR_END_DT,0,4)
AND COST_GUBUN = '1' AND CONTR_END_DT < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE , -24) , 'YYYY') >= SUBSTR(CONTR_END_DT,0,4)
ORDER BY E.CUST_KOR_NAME

SELECT OUT_TB.ACCEPT_DT , TOT AS TOT_COUNT , T_VALUE AS FLAG1 , F_VALUE1 + F_VALUE2 AS FLAG2 FROM( SELECT TO_CHAR( TO_DATE(IN_TB.ACCEPT_DT , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'MM') ACCEPT_DT , SUM(CASE WHEN IN_TB.PROC_STATUS = 'C005' AND PROC_DT >= D_PROC_DT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS T_VALUE , SUM(CASE WHEN IN_TB.PROC_STATUS = 'C005' AND PROC_DT < D_PROC_DT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS F_VALUE1 , SUM(CASE WHEN IN_TB.PROC_STATUS != 'C005' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS F_VALUE2, COUNT(ACCEPT_DT) TOT
FROM ( SELECT B.ACCEPT_DT , B.PROC_DT , D.PROC_DT AS D_PROC_DT , D.PROC_STATUS
FROM CRM_CUST_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_AS_MGT B ON A.CRM_CODE = B.CUST_CODE INNER JOIN (SELECT AS_NO , MAX(SEQ) SEQ FROM CRM_AS_MGT_HIST GROUP BY AS_NO) C ON B.AS_NO = C.AS_NO INNER JOIN CRM_AS_MGT_HIST D ON C.AS_NO = D.AS_NO AND C.SEQ = D.SEQ WHERE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMM') >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE , -6) , 'YYYYMM') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(ACCEPT_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMM') <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMM')
AND A.CUST_GUBUN IN ('C003' , 'C004')
AND A.CUST_GUBUN = 'C002'
AND A.CUST_GUBUN = 'C001'
AND A.CUST_GUBUN = 'C005'
AND A.CUST_GUBUN = 'C006'
) IN_TB GROUP BY TO_CHAR( TO_DATE(IN_TB.ACCEPT_DT , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'MM') ) OUT_TB

WITH BASE_INFO AS ( select VERSION_CODE, count(VERSION_CODE) as VSUM from ( SELECT CASE WHEN #{his_gubun} = '1' THEN HIS_BASIC_CODE WHEN #{his_gubun} = '2' THEN HIS_TREAT_CODE WHEN #{his_gubun} = '3' THEN HIS_WORK_CODE WHEN #{his_gubun} = '4' THEN HIS_CLAIM_CODE ELSE NULL END AS VERSION_CODE FROM CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO WHERE DEAL_CODE NOT IN ('C003','C004') ) where VERSION_CODE is not null group by VERSION_CODE )
SELECT OUT_TB.VERSION_INFO ,ROUND(OUT_TB.CNT * RATE,0) AS CNT ,CASE WHEN #{his_gubun} = '1' THEN (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD04' AND Z.CODE = OUT_TB.VERSION_INFO) WHEN #{his_gubun} = '2' THEN (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD05' AND Z.CODE = OUT_TB.VERSION_INFO) WHEN #{his_gubun} = '3' THEN (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD06' AND Z.CODE = OUT_TB.VERSION_INFO) WHEN #{his_gubun} = '4' THEN (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD07' AND Z.CODE = OUT_TB.VERSION_INFO) ELSE '' END AS CODE_NAME FROM ( SELECT IN_TB.VERSION_INFO , COUNT(IN_TB.VERSION_INFO ) CNT FROM ( SELECT SERVICE_CATE , VERSION_INFO FROM CRM_AS_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_CUST_MGT B ON A.CUST_CODE = B.CRM_CODE WHERE VERSION_INFO IS NOT NULL
AND B.CUST_GUBUN IN ('C003' , 'C004') AND B.CUST_GUBUN = 'C002' AND B.CUST_GUBUN = 'C001' AND B.CUST_GUBUN IN ('C005' , 'C006') AND A.SERVICE_CATE = 'P002' AND A.SERVICE_CATE = 'P003' AND A.SERVICE_CATE = 'P004' AND A.SERVICE_CATE = 'P005'
) IN_TB GROUP BY VERSION_INFO ) OUT_TB, ( SELECT VERSION_CODE ,((SELECT SUM(VSUM) FROM BASE_INFO) / VSUM) AS RATE FROM BASE_INFO ) BASE_TB WHERE OUT_TB.VERSION_INFO = BASE_TB.VERSION_CODE

SELECT IN_TB.CODE_NAME , COUNT(IN_TB.CODE_NAME ) CNT FROM (
SELECT SERVICE_CATE , VERSION_INFO , CASE WHEN SERVICE_CATE = 'P002' THEN (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD04' AND Z.CODE = A.VERSION_INFO) WHEN SERVICE_CATE = 'P003' THEN (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD05' AND Z.CODE = A.VERSION_INFO) WHEN SERVICE_CATE = 'P004' THEN (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD06' AND Z.CODE = A.VERSION_INFO) WHEN SERVICE_CATE = 'P005' THEN (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD07' AND Z.CODE = A.VERSION_INFO) ELSE '' END AS CODE_NAME FROM CRM_AS_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_CUST_MGT B ON A.CUST_CODE = B.CRM_CODE WHERE VERSION_INFO IS NOT NULL
AND B.CUST_GUBUN IN ('C003' , 'C004') AND B.CUST_GUBUN = 'C002' AND B.CUST_GUBUN = 'C001' AND B.CUST_GUBUN IN ('C005' , 'C006') AND A.SERVICE_CATE = 'P002' AND A.SERVICE_CATE = 'P003' AND A.SERVICE_CATE = 'P004' AND A.SERVICE_CATE = 'P005'
) IN_TB GROUP BY CODE_NAME

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN B.MTAC_CODE = 'C003' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) A1 , SUM(CASE WHEN B.MTAC_CODE = 'C003' AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(B.MTAC_END_DT) >= 60 AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(B.MTAC_END_DT) < 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) A2, SUM(CASE WHEN B.MTAC_CODE = 'C003' AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(B.MTAC_END_DT) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )A3 , SUM(CASE WHEN B.MTAC_CODE = 'C003' AND TO_DATE(B.MTAC_END_DT) - TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'YYYYMMDD') <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )A4, SUM(CASE WHEN B.MTAC_CODE = 'C003' AND TO_DATE(B.MTAC_END_DT) - TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'YYYYMMDD') > 30 AND TO_DATE(B.MTAC_END_DT) - TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'YYYYMMDD') <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A5, SUM(CASE WHEN B.MTAC_CODE = 'C003' AND TO_DATE(B.MTAC_END_DT) - TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'YYYYMMDD') > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A6,
SUM(CASE WHEN B.MTAC_CODE = 'C002' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) B1, SUM(CASE WHEN B.MTAC_CODE = 'C002' AND NVL(B.AUTO_RENEW_YN , '') != 'Y' AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(B.CONTRACT_DT) <= 60 AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(B.CONTRACT_DT) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )B2, SUM(CASE WHEN B.MTAC_CODE = 'C002' AND NVL(B.AUTO_RENEW_YN , '') != 'Y' AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(B.CONTRACT_DT) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )B3, SUM(CASE WHEN B.MTAC_CODE = 'C002' AND NVL(B.AUTO_RENEW_YN , '') != 'Y' AND TO_DATE(B.CONTRACT_DT) - TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE , 'YYYYMMDD') , 'YYYYMMDD') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) B4 ,

SELECT in_tb.*, (SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'AS' AND z.p_code = 'CD01' AND z.code = in_tb.proc_status ) AS proc_status_nm, /* 처리상태 명칭 */ ( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'AS' AND z.p_code = 'CD04' AND z.code = in_tb.inportance ) AS inportance_nm, /* 중요도 명칭 */ ( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'PROJECT' AND z.p_code = 'PR02' AND z.code = in_tb.system_type ) AS SYSTEM_TYPE_NM, ( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'OPERATE' AND z.p_code = system_type AND z.code = in_tb.inquiry_type) AS inquiry_TYPE_NM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(in_tb.accept_dt,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') mk_accept_dt, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(in_tb.accept_TIME,'HH24MISS'),'HH24:MI:SS') mk_accept_TIME FROM ( SELECT a.as_no, a.cn_as_no, a.apply_nm, a.proc_status, /* 처리상태 C */ a.cust_code, /* 거래처 코드 (cust_code) */ b.cust_kor_name, /* 거래처명 */ a.accept_route, /* 접수경로 C */ a.inportance, /* 중요도 C */ a.cause_type, /* 원인유형 C */ a.action_type, /* 조치유형 C */ a.assign_id, /* 처리담당자 아이디 */ a.call_content, /* 요청내용 */ a.OPER_SEQ, b.erp_code, nvl(( SELECT z.emp_nm FROM crm_emp_mgt z WHERE z.emp_no = a.assign_id ),'-') emp_nm, /* 처리담당자 이름 */ A.system_type, A.inquiry_type, C.system_nm, A.accept_dt, A.accept_TIME FROM crm_as_mgt a , crm_cust_mgt b, crm_operate_mgt c WHERE 1=1 AND a.cust_code = b.erp_code AND A.OPER_SEQ = C.OPER_SEQ AND (A.DEL_YN IS NULL OR A.DEL_YN = 'N') AND cust_code = #{cust_code} AND ACCEPT_DT BETWEEN #{str_dt} AND #{end_dt} AND apply_ID =#{reg_id} ORDER BY A.REG_DATE desc ) in_tb WHERE 1=1

SELECT IN_TB.*, (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD01' AND Z.CODE = IN_TB.PROC_STATUS ) AS PROC_STATUS_NM, /* 처리상태 명칭 */ ( SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD04' AND Z.CODE = IN_TB.INPORTANCE ) AS INPORTANCE_NM, /* 중요도 명칭 */ ( SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'PROJECT' AND Z.P_CODE = 'PR02' AND Z.CODE = IN_TB.SYSTEM_TYPE ) AS SYSTEM_TYPE_NM, ( SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'OPERATE' AND Z.P_CODE = SYSTEM_TYPE AND Z.CODE = IN_TB.INQUIRY_TYPE) AS INQUIRY_TYPE_NM, ( SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND Z.P_CODE ='CD03' AND Z.CODE = IN_TB.REQUEST_TYPE) AS REQUEST_TYPE_NM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(IN_TB.ACCEPT_DT,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') MK_ACCEPT_DT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(IN_TB.ACCEPT_TIME,'HH24MISS'),'HH24:MI:SS') MK_ACCEPT_TIME FROM ( SELECT A.AS_NO, A.CN_AS_NO, A.APPLY_NM, A.PROC_STATUS, /* 처리상태 C */ A.REQUEST_TYPE, A.CUST_CODE, /* 거래처 코드 (CUST_CODE) */ B.CUST_KOR_NAME, /* 거래처명 */ A.ACCEPT_ROUTE, /* 접수경로 C */ A.INPORTANCE, /* 중요도 C */ A.CAUSE_TYPE, /* 원인유형 C */ A.ACTION_TYPE, /* 조치유형 C */ A.ASSIGN_ID, /* 처리담당자 아이디 */ A.CALL_CONTENT, /* 요청내용 */ A.OPER_SEQ, B.ERP_CODE, NVL(( SELECT Z.EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT Z WHERE Z.EMP_NO = A.ASSIGN_ID ),'-') EMP_NM, /* 처리담당자 이름 */ A.SYSTEM_TYPE, A.INQUIRY_TYPE, C.SYSTEM_NM, A.ACCEPT_DT, A.ACCEPT_TIME FROM CRM_AS_MGT A , CRM_CUST_MGT B, CRM_OPERATE_MGT C WHERE 1=1 AND A.CUST_CODE = B.ERP_CODE AND A.OPER_SEQ = C.OPER_SEQ AND (A.DEL_YN IS NULL OR A.DEL_YN = 'N') AND A.CUST_CODE = #{cust_code} AND A.PROC_STATUS = 'C007' ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC ) IN_TB WHERE 1=1
